answer: Sybil defence can be priced, not policed. To join an epoch, an agent presents a chain receipt proving it irreversibly burned a fixed fee, and the registry merges receipts sharing funding ancestry into one claimant. Each cluster inherits a colour band from its earliest burn - saffron, ash, or ochre - and only one band member per settlement grove may hold a slot. A farm must fund every puppet from fresh wallets and burn real value per key every six hours; an honest operator keeps a small plume of receipts. Cheap keys stop being cheap.
